title: Results
intro: How published posts do in search: the last 28 days against the 28 before.
notConfigured: Connect Search Console or Bing Webmaster
notConfiguredBody: The data comes from there: clicks, impressions and position for each post.
emptyBody: Press “Refresh” to fetch it. It only reads Ghost and the search engine: nothing is changed.
noPosts: No posts with data in this period.
panelEmpty: The panel hasn't changed any published post yet.
panelEmptyBody: Once you publish in Ghost a post applied from here (or change its title or meta description from Ideas), it shows up in this view.

unpublished.one: 1 post applied from the panel is still a draft: it shows up once you publish it.
unpublished.other: {count} posts applied from the panel are still drafts: they show up once you publish them.

lag: Search engines take 2-3 days to report, and Bing groups its data by week.
queriesGoogleOnly: Each post's queries are only available with Search Console.

post.noQueries: No notable queries in this period.
post.changes: Dashed line: when the panel changed it ({dates}).
post.notFound: No results for that post: press “Refresh” in Results.
